fullDescription: Nexis IT style guide features a high-energy, dark-themed enterprise tech aesthetic. It utilizes a vibrant orange-to-red gradient against a deep black background (#0A0A0A) to create a sense of power and innovation. The design language is characterized by glassmorphism, architectural typography using Clash Grotesk and Satoshi, and subtle motion design. This style is ideally suited for high-growth SaaS, fintech, cybersecurity, and cloud infrastructure companies looking to project authority and cutting-edge technology.

structured.summary: A professional yet energetic enterprise landing page with a deep black theme, vibrant warm gradients, and glassmorphic UI components. It emphasizes strong visual hierarchy through bold, modern typography and high-contrast elements.

style.description: The style is defined by its 'Dark Enterprise' theme. Typography pairs the bold, geometric 'Clash Grotesk' for headlines with the clean, legible 'Satoshi' for body text. The color palette centers on a primary gradient (#FF4D00 to #C41E3A) used for accents, buttons, and text highlights. Components use glassmorphism with background blurs (12px) and subtle white borders (10% opacity) to create depth without clutter.
style.prompt:
Create a design system using a dark mode theme with a base background of #0A0A0A. Implement a primary gradient from #FF4D00 to #C41E3A (135deg). 

Typography Specs:
- Primary Headlines: 'Clash Grotesk', Bold, tracking-tight (up to 8xl/96px for hero).
- Body Text: 'Satoshi', font-size: 18px-20px, font-weight: 300-400, color: white with 60% opacity.
- Accents/Labels: Uppercase, tracking-widest, font-size: 12px.

Visual Elements:
- Glassmorphism: Cards with bg rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03), backdrop-filter: blur(12px), and border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1).
- Buttons: Primary buttons use the primary gradient with rounded-xl (12px) corners and a 300ms cubic-bezier transition. 
- Form Inputs: Background rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05), border 1px solid white/10, focused border-color #FF4D00.
- Animations: Floating radial mesh gradient (80px blur) in the background with a 10s 'float' keyframe animation; hover state transform: translateY(-5px) on cards.

layout_and_structure.description: A clean, section-based layout optimized for enterprise storytelling, moving from a high-impact hero section to technical service details and concluding with a lead-gen form.

prompts.prompt: Fixed top bar, height 80-90px. Background #0A0A0A at 80% opacity with backdrop-blur-md. Border-bottom: 1px solid white/5. Left: Logo with a 32px gradient square icon. Center: Nav links in white/70 with 40px spacing. Right: 'Schedule Consultation' button with rounded-full border white/20.

Padding-top: 160px. Center-aligned content. Top badge: pill-shaped, bg white/5, orange text #FF4D00 with a pulsing dot. Main Title: 8xl font, two lines, with bottom line featuring an italicized gradient span. Description: Max-width 2xl, font-light, white/60. Bottom CTAs: Two-button layout (Primary Gradient vs. Glass Card). Below CTAs: A 21:9 aspect ratio glassmorphic 'Showcase' card acting as a video/dashboard placeholder.

3-column grid layout with 24px gaps. Each card is a large glassmorphic rectangle with 32px (2rem) corner radius. Elements inside: 56px rounded-2xl icon container (10% opacity of accent colors), 24px bold title, 16px body text at white/50, and a bulleted list with orange icons at the bottom.

Split layout (50/50). Left side: 48px bold headline, descriptive text, and a vertical list of contact info with 48px icon containers. Right side: A 40px (2.5rem) rounded glassmorphic card containing a multi-field form. Form layout: Name and Company in a 2-column grid, Email and Message in full-width blocks.
Border-top white/5, padding 48px. Three-way split: Left: Grayscale logo at 50% opacity. Center: Copyright text white/40. Right: Social icon links (LinkedIn, Twitter, Github) in white/40.

special_ui_components.description: A card that elevates and brightens on hover.
special_ui_components.prompt: Implementation: background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); border-radius: 2rem; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1). On :hover, background changes to rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05), border-color to rgba(255, 77, 0, 0.4), and transform: translateY(-5px).

special_ui_components.description: A subtle, animated light source behind the hero content.
special_ui_components.prompt: Implementation: Create a div with position: absolute, 80% width, 120% height, top -20%, right -10%. background: radial-gradient(circle at 50% 50%, rgba(255, 77, 0, 0.15) 0%, rgba(196, 30, 58, 0.05) 50%, transparent 100%). filter: blur(80px); z-index: -1. Add a keyframe animation 'float' that moves it 30px on Y-axis and -20px on X-axis over 10s with an alternate loop.

structured.special_notes: MUST: Maintain a high level of transparency and blur on all glass elements to ensure they don't look 'solid'. MUST: Use white-space generously to maintain enterprise 'breathing room'. MUST: Use 'Clash Grotesk' exclusively for headers and 'Satoshi' for body to keep the technical-luxury feel. DO NOT: Use standard blue for links; stick to orange #FF4D00. DO NOT: Use harsh white for body text; keep it at 60-70% opacity for better readability on black backgrounds.
